brief.goal: Make normal new-account workbench readonly progression Gate-driven and automatic until the next write confirmation, real blocker, or completion.
database_write_scope: Task, Manifest, state, design, and mechanism documentation

allowed_writes: Task, Context Manifest, project state, Solution Design, AGENTS, and current mechanism docs
workbench readonly orchestration and focused smoke tests
forbidden_actions: all real platform writes, confirmations, monitor creates, resource creates, project creates, retries, token refreshes, and budget or bid changes
new database schema, endpoint, Gate, Plan/action type, or write authorization path
raw credential, request, response, transcript, URL, or payload persistence
validation_plan: new-account Gate-first no-monitor and monitor-ready readonly progression tests
workbench conversation, runtime policy, monitor, API, and diff checks
stop_conditions: any real platform write would be required
the change weakens active/latest Case checks, exact Plan confirmation, fresh readonly, or no-retry rules
the change requires a new Schema, endpoint, Plan/action type, or external coordination

completion.result: Implemented Gate-first bounded readonly auto-advance for normal workbench startup and post-confirmation flow; no real platform writes were performed.
